about.description:
Filament is a real-time physically based rendering engine for Android,
iOS, Windows, Linux, macOS, and WebGL2. This package provides host-side
command line tools and a constrained shared C++ development surface for
downstream consumers.
The optional filament-filagui-static output is built against Dear ImGui
1.92.9 docking headers but does not package or link an ImGui
implementation. Consumers must link exactly one matching implementation:
conda-forge's mainline imgui package or their own docking build.
about.license: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND MIT AND Zlib
about.license_family: Apache-2.0 AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND MIT AND Zlib

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: filament
  version: "1.76.1"
  imgui_version: "1.92.9"
  python: "3.12"

recipe:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/google/filament/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: f65b5b50ef5647a190b51a37fa006985e061bcfdc87c3b9b0ea18cf7b52042aa
    patches:
      # Remove when upstream guards the macOS 12-only enum values, or when the
      # conda-forge build moves to a macOS 12+ SDK.
      - patches/0001-guard-newer-metal-command-buffer-errors.patch
      # Backport google/filament#10299; remove when upstream lands an equivalent fix.
      - patches/0002-fix-neon-mask-types.patch
      # Remove when upstream supports selecting these system dependencies.
      - patches/0003-use-system-libpng-zlib.patch
      # Remove when upstream supports shared-library builds (google/filament#1075).
      - patches/0004-build-selected-shared-libraries.patch
      # Remove with the shared-library patch, or when upstream supports Windows DLLs.
      - patches/0005-fix-windows-shared-library-boundaries.patch
      # Build Filagui against the selected consumer-compatible ImGui sources.
      - patches/0006-use-selected-imgui-source.patch
      # Use the current ImDrawData API required by Dear ImGui 1.92.9 docking.
      - patches/0007-use-current-imgui-command-list-api.patch
  # Build Filagui and test its consumer-supplied ImGui contract against docking.
  - url: https://github.com/ocornut/imgui/archive/refs/tags/v${{ imgui_version }}-docking.tar.gz
    sha256: 61f2ec7ef19702e47689b77cc602e3aeeda423941bfbc5d8ecb6a02d05a9dd73
    target_directory: imgui-docking

build:
  number: 2

outputs:
  - staging:
      name: filament-build
    build:
      script:
        - if: unix
          then: build.sh
          else: build.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - python ${{ python }}.*
      host:
        - assimp
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: libegl-devel
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: libgl-devel
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: libgles-devel
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: libxcb
        - libpng
        # Use Filament's bundled copy until conda-forge publishes meshoptimizer
        # for Windows, Apple Silicon, and Linux Arm/PPC.
        - if: target_platform in ("linux-64", "osx-64")
          then: meshoptimizer
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: xorg-libx11
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: xorg-xorgproto
        - zlib
        - zstd
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
            then: libgles-devel

  - package:
      name: filament
    inherit: filament-build
    build:
      files:
        - LICENSE
        - README.md
        - bin/*
        - docs/*
        - include/backend
        - include/filaflat
        - include/filament
        - include/filameshio
        - include/geometry
        - include/math
        - include/utils
        - lib/cmake/Filament
        - lib/lib*.dylib
        - lib/lib*.so*
        - Library/bin/*
        - Library/include/backend
        - Library/include/filaflat
        - Library/include/filament
        - Library/include/filameshio
        - Library/include/geometry
        - Library/include/math
        - Library/include/utils
        - Library/lib/backend.lib
        - Library/lib/bluegl.lib
        - Library/lib/bluevk.lib
        - Library/lib/cmake/Filament
        - Library/lib/filabridge.lib
        - Library/lib/filaflat.lib
        - Library/lib/filament.lib
        - Library/lib/filameshio.lib
        - Library/lib/geometry.lib
        - Library/lib/utils.lib
    requirements:
      # Staging requirements are not inherited once an output adds requirements.
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - python ${{ python }}.*
      host:
        - assimp
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: libegl-devel
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: libgl-devel
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: libgles-devel
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: libxcb
        - libpng
        - if: target_platform in ("linux-64", "osx-64")
          then: meshoptimizer
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: xorg-libx11
        - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
          then: xorg-xorgproto
        - zlib
        - zstd
      run:
        - if: target_platform in ("linux-64", "osx-64")
          then: meshoptimizer
        - tsl_robin_map
        - zstd
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('filament', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - if: linux and target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
            then: libgles-devel
    tests:
      - files:
          recipe:
            - bakedColor.mat
            - check_package_payload.py
            - test-cmake-core
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - cmake
            - ninja
            - python ${{ python }}.*
        script:
          - python check_package_payload.py
          - cmake -S test-cmake-core -B test-cmake-core-build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          - cmake --build test-cmake-core-build --verbose
          - ctest --test-dir test-cmake-core-build --output-on-failure --no-tests=error
          - matc --help
          - matinfo --help
          - cmgen --help
          - filamesh --help
          - if: target_platform != "linux-ppc64le"
            then: matc -a opengl -p desktop -o bakedColor.filamat bakedColor.mat
          - if: target_platform == "linux-ppc64le"
            then: matc -a vulkan -p desktop -o bakedColor.filamat bakedColor.mat

  - package:
      name: filament-filagui-static
    inherit:
      from: filament-build
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - include/filagui
        - lib/libfilagui.a
        - Library/include/filagui
        - Library/lib/filagui.lib
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('filament', exact=True) }}
      # Do not install ImGui: applications may link either mainline or docking.
      # If conda-forge's mainline package is present, keep its ABI version aligned.
      run_constraints:
        - imgui ==${{ imgui_version }}
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          include:
            - filagui/ImGuiHelper.h
          files:
            - if: win
              then: Library/lib/filagui.lib
            - if: unix
              then: lib/libfilagui.a
      - files:
          recipe:
            - bakedColor.mat
            - test-cmake
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - cmake
            - imgui ==${{ imgui_version }}
            - libvulkan-headers
            - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
              then: libvulkan-loader
            - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
              then: mesa-lavapipe
            - ninja
            - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
              then: xorg-libx11
            - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
              then: xorg-xorgproto
        script:
          - cmake -S test-cmake -B test-cmake-mainline-build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release
          - cmake --build test-cmake-mainline-build --verbose
          - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
            then: VK_DRIVER_FILES="$PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json" xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 640x480x24 -ac -extension GLX +extension RANDR" ./test-cmake-mainline-build/hello_world
          - if: unix and target_platform != "linux-64"
            then: ./test-cmake-mainline-build/hello_world
          - if: win
            then: .\test-cmake-mainline-build\hello_world.exe
      - files:
          recipe:
            - bakedColor.mat
            - test-cmake
          source:
            - imgui-docking
        requirements:
          run:
            - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
            - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
            - cmake
            - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
              then: libvulkan-loader
            - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
              then: mesa-lavapipe
            - ninja
            - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
              then: xorg-libx11
            - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
              then: xorg-xorgproto
        script:
          - cmake -S test-cmake -B test-cmake-docking-build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DFILAGUI_TEST_DOCKING=ON
          - cmake --build test-cmake-docking-build --verbose
          - if: target_platform == "linux-64"
            then: VK_DRIVER_FILES="$PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json" xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 640x480x24 -ac -extension GLX +extension RANDR" ./test-cmake-docking-build/hello_world
          - if: unix and target_platform != "linux-64"
            then: ./test-cmake-docking-build/hello_world
          - if: win
            then: .\test-cmake-docking-build\hello_world.exe
